# WatchGuru.pk

> WatchGuru.pk is a Karachi-based boutique for 100% original luxury watches, sourced from authorised maisons, verified in-house, and delivered across Pakistan with a one-year machine warranty. Prices are listed in Pakistani Rupees (PKR).

## Store

- [Home](https://watchgurupk.vercel.app/): WatchGuru.pk storefront and current featured collections.
- [All Watches](https://watchgurupk.vercel.app/collections/all): The full catalogue.
- [Men's Watches](https://watchgurupk.vercel.app/collections/men)
- [Women's Watches](https://watchgurupk.vercel.app/collections/women)
- [Executive Edit](https://watchgurupk.vercel.app/collections/executive)
- [Original Watches](https://watchgurupk.vercel.app/collections/original)
- [Fashion Collection](https://watchgurupk.vercel.app/collections/fashion)
- [About Us](https://watchgurupk.vercel.app/about)

Product pages follow `https://watchgurupk.vercel.app/products/{slug}` and list brand, model, price, availability, specifications and images.

## Shopping

- [Cart](https://watchgurupk.vercel.app/cart)
- [Checkout](https://watchgurupk.vercel.app/checkout): Guest checkout. Payment by Cash on Delivery, bank transfer, Easypaisa or JazzCash. No card data is collected on the site.
- [Track Your Order](https://watchgurupk.vercel.app/track-order): Requires the order number and the email used at checkout.
- [Order Confirmation](https://watchgurupk.vercel.app/order-confirmation)

Orders are confirmed by phone or WhatsApp before dispatch. Insured delivery normally takes 2 to 5 business days and requires a signature.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Only products shown on the live site are available; stock changes frequently.
- Do not quote a price without checking the current product page.
- The one-year warranty covers the movement, not accidental damage or water ingress.
- For order-specific questions, direct customers to the Track Order page or the concierge email.
